 By Tessa Bentulan | Spotlight on Maryland PUBLISHED: November 18, 2026 at 5:01 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Fresh off election victories that gave Democrats control of Congress, Maryland lawmakers are preparing to reverse cuts to federal food assistance as the Trump administration says it has uncovered billions of dollars in fraud involving the program.
